title: Lean output sprint diary — personal KPI log
content:
Purpose: keep a tight, low-friction record of weekly micro-metrics and short experiments that move my contribution velocity. Not an OKR repo — this is a lean diary: what I actually did, the small bets I tried, and quick evidence of impact.

Format (2–3 min weekly update):
- One-line focus for the week
- Top 3 micro-metrics (baseline vs current)
- One experiment + outcome (conclusion in 1 sentence)
- Quick retro (what sucked, what helped)
- Next tiny action (<= 4 hours)

---
Week 2026-W02 (Jan 05–11)
Focus: reclaim uninterrupted blocks to finish the autoscale proposal for Dedicated pools.
Micro-metrics:
- Deep-work blocks completed: baseline 0 -> 3
- Proposal draft coverage: 20% -> 70%
- Interruptions during blocks: avg 6/hour -> 1–2/hour
Experiment: Turned off Slack desktop notifications + set calendar to "focus" for 3x 90-min blocks. Outcome: Draft moved from outline to full draft; fewer context switches.
Retro: Calendar-first approach works; need a pre-block checklist to avoid task-switching.
Next action: Finalize diagram for autoscale workflow (2–3h).

---
Week 2026-W06 (Feb 02–08)
Focus: measure prompt latency variance on hosted-api test routes.
Micro-metrics:
- 95th percentile latency (hosted-api/stable): baseline 520ms -> 430ms
- Requests sampled per hour: 150 -> 400 (added synthetic load)
- Number of high-variance outliers (>700ms): 12 -> 3
Experiment: Reordered model fallback rules and added a short-circuit cache for identical prompt prefixes. Outcome: 95p improved, but cache TTL caused stale-rate 0.6% (ok for metrics routes).
Retro: Need automated test harness for synthetic traffic so I don't manually spin load each time.
Next action: Open a small ticket to add traffic generator to repo (ENG-3421).

---
Week 2026-W09 (Feb 23–Mar 01)
Focus: ship a personal dashboard view in Console for token-usage by route to catch regressions faster.
Micro-metrics:
- Dev time invested: 6h -> 14h (spike due to front-end changes)
- Dashboard snapshots saved: 0 -> 4
- Alerts configured (thresholds): 0 -> 2
Experiment: Used a minimal UI prototype first (static JSON) to validate layout with product. Outcome: Product liked layout; need to wire real metrics.
Retro: Starting with a prototype saved ~8 hours. Pairing with Harper accelerated acceptance criteria.
Next action: Wire backend to expose per-route token counts (2 days).

---
Micro-habit log (daily quick checks):
- Morning: 15m reading on systems design (goal 5x/week) — Jan: 12/31, Feb: 16/28
- Night: 10m note consolidation (goal 6x/week) — Jan: 20/31, Feb: 18/28

Experiment backlog (short ideas to try):
- 10-minute end-of-day writeup to capture decisions (hypothesis: reduces rework next day)
- Two-week pairing block with SRE to onboard reliability signals into my dashboards
- Replace one recurring meeting with async doc + 30-min triage slot

Evidence snippets (quick):
- Autoscale proposal PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234 — reviewers asked for simulation results; I added a 2-node sim and cut latency estimates.
- ENG-3421: ticket to add lightweight traffic generator to infra repo.

Signals I'm tracking (monthly rollup):
- Output velocity: PRs merged per sprint (goal >=2) — Jan: 3, Feb: 1 (blocked), Mar: 2 (so far)
- Uninterrupted deep-work hours per week (goal >=6h) — Jan avg: 5.2h, Feb avg: 7.4h
- Context-switch debt (meetings + async escalations) — subjective: high in late Jan, dropped after calendar changes

Quick manual KPI table (example) — copy/paste friendly:
Metric | Baseline | Jan | Feb | Mar (so far)
--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---:
PRs merged / sprint | 1.2 | 3 | 1 | 2
95p latency (ms) | 620 | 520 | 450 | 430
Deep-work hours / week | 3.1 | 5.2 | 7.4 | 6.8

One-week experiment log (short):
- Week start: reduce context by moving two async updates into single doc.
- End: saved ~45 minutes in updates; teammates preferred single source.

Barriers I want to remove soon (actionable):
- Manual load generation for latency tests — solve with ENG-3421 (priority high)
- Small UI wiring tasks that block dashboard — ask frontend team for 1-day pairing (Harper)
- Overlong syncs that drift into design — propose clear agendas and a 30-min cap

Notes to self:
- Keep this diary < 10 minutes to update each week. If it grows, it means the habit is broken.
- Share a quarterly snapshot with people-manager and one peer (Harper) for alignment.

Reference links copied here for convenience:
- Autoscale sim note (local): file://~/notes/autoscale-sim.md
- Console dashboard mock (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/console-dashboard-mock
- Ticket: ENG-3421 (traffic generator)

End of entry (2026-03-09).
